concept.title: Illumination Comparison
concept.purpose: Manually compare the appearance of a flat panel under two lamp positions using only the supplied desk lamp and flat panel.
concept.reasoning: This configuration allows for manual positioning and comparison of the panel's appearance, leveraging the capabilities of the desk lamp and flat panel. The manual process ensures that no external resources or tools are used, adhering to the specified constraints.
concept.newUse: Propose a simple setup for illumination comparison using only the supplied components.

roles.label: lamp
roles.explanation: The desk lamp is used to provide light for illumination comparison.

roles.label: panel
roles.explanation: The flat panel serves as the subject for manual comparison of its appearance under different lighting conditions.

steps.title: Position Lamp 1
steps.instruction: Place the desk lamp on a stable surface, ensuring good ventilation around it.

steps.title: Position Panel 1
steps.instruction: Carefully place the flat panel under the light source of the lamp, adjusting its position as needed to achieve even illumination.

steps.title: Compare Appearance
steps.instruction: Manually compare the appearance of the panel under the current lighting conditions, taking note of any differences or observations.

steps.title: Position Lamp 2
steps.instruction: Move the desk lamp to a different position, adjusting its height and angle as needed to achieve a new lighting configuration.

steps.title: Position Panel 2
steps.instruction: Repeat the placement of the flat panel under the new light source, ensuring even illumination.

steps.title: Compare Appearance (Again)
steps.instruction: Manually compare the appearance of the panel under the second lighting configuration, noting any differences or observations.
